records.text: Josh Hammer was given a show on the Salem Podcast Network on October 15 despite having very low viewership.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: No one listens to him. No one watches him. And somehow on October 15th. He's given a show on the Salem podcast network, the same network that hosts the Charlie Kirk show.

verification.notes: Salem officially announced that The Josh Hammer Show joined its podcast network, but the announcement was October 13, 2025, not October 15. The assertion of very low viewership is subjective and was not substantiated by a disclosed audience dataset.

sources.title: Salem Podcast Network Adds The Josh Hammer Show in Partnership with Newsweek
sources.relevance: Primary Salem announcement confirms the addition and gives the October 13 date.
